title.zh: 美SEC起诉Linqto两名前高管，指控其涉嫌欺诈散户逾4.3亿美元
title.en: 美SEC起诉Linqto两名前高管，指控其涉嫌欺诈散户逾4.3亿美元

current_state.zh: The SEC sued former Linqto executives William Sarris and Joseph Endoso, alleging they defrauded thousands of retail investors of more than $430 million by selling mispriced, unregistered pre-IPO SPV interests and misrepresenting pricing and demand.
current_state.en: The SEC sued former Linqto executives William Sarris and Joseph Endoso, alleging they defrauded thousands of retail investors of more than $430 million by selling mispriced, unregistered pre-IPO SPV interests and misrepresenting pricing and demand.
